measures.title: Special one percent sales and use tax (SPLOST 2028)
measures.summary: Asks whether to impose a special one percent sales and use tax across all of Jefferson County for up to six years to raise an estimated $14,000,000 for county and city capital projects. About $7.7 million would go to Jefferson County (roads, public safety, fire equipment, solid waste and landfill, parks, government buildings and vehicles, industrial parks, and Hospital Authority facility improvements), with the rest divided among Avera, Bartow, Louisville, Stapleton, Wadley and Wrens for city projects such as public safety equipment, utilities, streets, parks and buildings.
measures.yesMeans: A one percent special purpose sales and use tax would be imposed in Jefferson County for up to six years to fund the listed county and city projects.
measures.noMeans: The special purpose sales and use tax would not be imposed.
